```{=html}
.cell-output-markdown:has(> table) {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;

  white-space: nowrap;

</style>
```

```{python}
#| include: false

from IPython.display import Markdown, display

def show_table(frame):
    def cell(value):
        if value is None:
            return ""
        return f"{value:.2f}" if isinstance(value, float) else str(value)

    rows = [frame.columns, [":--", *["--:"] * (frame.width - 1)]]
    rows += [[cell(value) for value in row] for row in frame.iter_rows()]
    display(Markdown("\n".join("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |" for row in rows)))
```
